summary: Prudential plc furnished a Form 6-K disclosing a routine PDMR shareholding notification under UK/EU market abuse rules. Regional CEO Dennis Tan acquired 313 ordinary shares of 5 pence each at nil cost via the Prudential All Employee Share Purchase Plan (matching shares), transaction dated 2026-09-30 on the London Stock Exchange. No price, premium, stake change of significance, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. This is an administrative insider-dealing disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms, overhang, or regulatory clock applies. No risk-arb angle arises from an employee share-plan award.
